title: Confirm valuation rate for additional interlocking paving
description: Review BOQ item L-05-050 against the added 400.0 m2 of interlocking paving on drawing L-301 and confirm whether the existing BOQ rate applies under clause 13.3, or whether a new rate must be agreed because no similar item exists. Also confirm whether the rate already includes bedding sand and edge restraints as noted on the drawing comparison.
reason: Clause 13.3 requires valuation by BOQ rates where the work is of similar character and executed under similar conditions, and new rates only where no similar item exists.
